verdict.rationale: cubic's CLI generates a prompt your coding agent can use to fix the bugs it finds. Its official MCP server lets coding agents read review findings and triage PR issues, and the docs give setup steps for Cursor, Claude Code, Codex and others. Skills also guide agents in handling PR comments. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the agent handoff workflow; detail on copyable fix prompts for PR-level (not just local CLI) findings.
